name: Arturia MatrixBrute
description: Arturia MatrixBrute analog synthesizer: every controller of its manual's MIDI continuous controller assignments.

sources.title: MatrixBrute User Manual 2.0.3
sources.notes: MIDI CC chart (pages 55, 56, 57, 58 of the PDF) read by tools/profiles/arturia/read-arturia-cc.mjs from matrixbrute_Manual_2_0_3_EN.pdf (sha256 167bc06721acde8c0b6fc0eebfc08a44e8bdbd8d8c7462f074bf4c67361dd203), https://dl.arturia.net/products/matrixbrute/manual/matrixbrute_Manual_2_0_3_EN.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/arturia/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/arturia/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC chart, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The chart prints controller numbers only: every value is the controller's 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list (a waveform, an oscillator type) is a number here, not a choice.
Controllers the chart gives to a pedal or wheel and to a knob, laid out as the knob: CC 3 (Expr. Pedal 2; MACRO KNOBS M4), CC 4 (Expr. Pedal 1; MACRO KNOBS M3).

Rows the chart misprints, corrected by the layout from the manual's own text: CC 95 (printed ENV 2 (VCF): Velo / VCF; the manual's text calls it Velo/VCA, on ENV 2 only); CC 105 (printed ENV 2 (VCF): Attack; the manual's text calls the second envelope ENV 2 (VCA)); CC 106 (printed ENV 2 (VCF): Decay; the manual's text calls the second envelope ENV 2 (VCA)); CC 29 (printed ENV 2 (VCF): Sustain; the manual's text calls the second envelope ENV 2 (VCA)); CC 107 (printed ENV 2 (VCF): Release; the manual's text calls the second envelope ENV 2 (VCA)).

The chart gives CC 2, CC 3, CC 4, CC 5, CC 7, CC 8, CC 9, CC 10, CC 11, CC 12, CC 13, CC 14, CC 15, CC 16, CC 17, CC 18, CC 19, CC 20, CC 21, CC 22, CC 23, CC 24, CC 25, CC 26, CC 27, CC 28, CC 29, CC 30, CC 31 as 7-bit/14-bit and prints no fine controller for them; they are sent as 7 bits.
Left out, the wheels, ribbon and pedals: CC 64 Sustain Pedal, CC 3 Expr. Pedal 2, CC 4 Expr. Pedal 1, CC 1 Modulation.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its knobs are turned, where its MIDI settings allow
